releases.displayName: November 12 Update | Balance Adjustments and Bug Fixes

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/18b0a67499e6a554c5bcf328fd294657c787c19e.jpg"]Hello, Operators:

We'll be rolling out an update on November 12 with no downtime. Gameplay and matchmaking will not be affected. If you encounter any issues after the update, please restart the game to complete the update. If your game client is out of date, you'll need to update to the latest version to log in.

notes.title: The main highlights of this update include

items.text: Assault Operator - Martelo Balance Adjustments
○ Adjusted the sound attenuation range to 50 meters and increased sound attenuation beyond 30 meters;
○ The mechanical sound played when turning the camera while holding Smoke Halo can now only be heard by Martelo.
S12 Fate Contracts: Expert Handler - Return Difficulty Adjustments

● In any Hard Operation, while playing as Rover, use Man's Best Friend to identify 8 enemy Operators through Irritant → In any Hard Operation, while playing as Rover, hit enemy Operators a total of 6 times with Dart Rifle;
● In any Hard Operation, while playing as Martelo, use Ariete to hit a total of 6 enemy Operators → In any Hard Operation, while playing as Martelo, use Ariete to hit a total of 3 enemy Operators;
Warfare Balance Adjustments

notes.title: ● Zenith Port Balance Adjustments and Fixes

items.text: ○ Adjusted existing Deployment Bases and added new ones for the attackers in Sector B;
○ Changed the vehicle made available to the attackers when reinforcements are low in Sector B to Wheeled Tank Destroyer;
○ Changed the defenders' deployment vehicle in Sector C to an Infantry Fighting Vehicle;
○ Added one Deployment Base each for the attackers and defenders after the Riptide event in Sector C;
○ Fixed an issue with abnormal damage to characters and vehicles after buses exploded;
○ Fixed collision issues with certain buildings in Sector A;
○ Fixed an issue with redeployment locations in Sector B;
○ Fixed an issue where objectives were marked as destroyed too late when the Riptide event triggered.
○ Once a vehicle finishes servicing at a Vehicle Supply Station, all Vehicle Supply Stations will enter the servicing cooldown simultaneously.
Optimizations and Bug Fixes
● Improved the lighting effects in the Raptor - Breath of Thunder intro animation;
● Fixed a delay in the animation when equipping Raptor's Silver Wing;
● Improved the localized text in the Operations season introduction;
● Fixed an issue where Gunsmith could not be unlocked in Warfare;
● Fixed an issue where standard pings and Rover's command pings could not pass through smoke;
● Fixed an issue where Weapon Crates could yield expired limited-time Attachments;
● Added tracks from S12 - Aurora to the lobby music player;
● Fixed an issue with the bait casting distance when using an underhand cast with a Fishing Rod;
● Fixed a delay when aiming down sights with a controller;
● Improved some interaction flows in Haavk faction missions;
● Fixed an issue with item rarity background colors in the Collection Room tab of the profile page;
● Fixed incorrect displays during animated emote interactions;
● Fixed an issue where share codes were not visible to other players in certain situations;
● Fixed an issue where item binding status was displayed incorrectly in the loadout interface;
● Fixed an issue where equipping certain weapons in the Firing Range caused the camera to become misaligned;
● Fixed an issue where interaction buttons could occasionally disappear in Detonation on mobile versions;
● Fixed an issue with the healing effects of Stinger's TPistol in Detonation;
● Fixed inconsistent left-lean angles with certain weapons;
● Fixed occasional character animation issues while inspecting the Harmonica.
That covers the main changes in this update. Thank you for your continued interest and support, Operators. Enjoy the game!
Delta Force Team

releases.displayName: Version Update | New Season "Aurora" Massive Events & Rewards & Store Updates

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/3ac99bfe22c08f1656544db31784dd5d940795be.jpg"]Dear Operators,
We're rolling out a no-downtime update for PC, mobile, and console on November 10 to launch our brand-new season: Aurora!

After the update is complete, jump into the game to explore all the new "Aurora" season modes and content, and grab some incredible rewards! If you run into any issues after updating, try restarting the game to finish things up.
Full details on this season's update are below. Dive in!
Events in All Modes
● Collab Legendary Gift[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/2ef70fdebff112c7dab7887b04c9e762e21f0029.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/3

Event Details: The Phantom Blade Zero collab is here in full force! Complete active missions to win the Limited Collab Legendary Firearm Appearance! During the event, accumulate in-match survival time in Operations, Warfare, or Detonation to earn event points and advance milestone progress. Claim the Limited Collab Legendary Firearm Appearance Seven-Star Sword - G3 and a massive amount of Tactical Armament Vouchers for free.
Event Rewards: Seven-Star Sword - G3, Tactical Armament Voucher
● Phantom Blade Zero Collab[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/3e1263e3033687b433578e4fe40df8318f820a15.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10

Event Details: The "Delta Force" × "Phantom Blade Zero" collaboration is live! During the event, take part in collab-related modes and active missions across all modes to unlock a variety of limited Chinese martial arts-inspired appearances and exclusive collab appearances for free.

Event Rewards: Charm - Flaming Mane, Calling Card - Delta Force × Phantom Blade Zero, Avatar - Lion Dance, Spray Paint - Red Threads, Action - Boundless Thirst, related collab actions (Drunken Sword - Solo, Lion Dance - Solo, Fish Flip - Duo, Ratty Action Response).
Operations & Warfare Events
● New Tactical Armament
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/c86b8ef86e24cf964567d4f71753c59dd19fefbb.png"]Event Time: 2026/11/10 - 2027/01/25

Event Details: 9 new firearm appearances have been added this season, including: Epic Firearm Appearances: Showdown *3: SV-98, K437, FS12; Rare Appearances: Ahsarah Guard: AK-74U, UZI; Special Ops: Desert Eagle, PSG-1, SMG-45, QBZ-95.
The red collectibles available from S12 Supply Packs have been updated as follows:
a) S12 Basic Supply Pack — Graphics Card, Quantum Storage
b) S12 Advanced Supply Pack — Military Shell, Golden Crocodile Head Statue
c) S12 Top Supply Pack — Battle Tank Model, Military Shell
Operations Events
● New Operator
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/109ab9ba4d505f9101fe4afcde061a5726c5cf0f.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10

Event Details: Unlock the new Operator "Martelo" and complete the skill trial missions to experience the battlefield spirit of Guerreira, and claim Tactical Armament Vouchers and an exclusive Calling Card cosmetic.
● Brakkesh Renewed
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/960e3fe9c5c5d23ace8638afb3c26ed20f9a13b1.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10

Event Details: Brakkesh 2.0 has arrived with a bang! Babel has been completely reworked, unlocking an all-new faction clash mode! During the event, dive deep into the Brakkesh map in Operations to experience the newly revamped Babel terrain and Central Command Zone layout. Find the mysterious contacts of the Ahsarah and Haavk factions to receive missions. Level up your faction badge and unlock faction milestones and hunting missions for a more tactically rich extraction and strategic experience!
● Faction Badge
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/a944b555a137be89e16045002b58d3e359ab64d1.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: The all-new faction clash mode is live! During the event, search for the hidden contact outposts of Ahsarah and Haavk in-match, choose your faction allegiance, and claim your exclusive faction badge. Level up your badge by completing faction missions. Once your badge reaches Lv.2, you'll unlock advanced clash modes like faction milestones and faction hunts, and enjoy richer faction tug-of-war and strategic gameplay as your badge levels up!
● Weekend Select
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f18e980ac736fade8e7f1799c5b9e67d3f5b3c27.png"]Event Time: 2026/11/10 - 2027/01/25

Event Details: Weekend-exclusive rewards are here! Log in and complete missions to earn Weekend Select Tokens, then exchange them for the tactical supplies you need. Weekend Select Tokens remain valid throughout the Reorientation season and will expire when the season ends.
1. Each week, complete designated missions in Operations mode between 00:00 Tuesday and 23:59:59 the following Monday to earn Weekend Select Tokens. Missions refresh every Tuesday.
2. Weekend Select Tokens can be used throughout the event. Any unused tokens will be cleared when the Reorientation season ends.

3. Spend Weekend Select Tokens to exchange for rewards. Each reward has a weekly exchange limit, which resets every Tuesday at 00:00. 4. Some rewards, such as the Lucky Pack, will change periodically. 5. Each week, you can exchange 2 Standard Gear Tickets and 2 Elite Gear Tickets for Weekend Select Tokens, which can then be used to exchange for other tactical supplies. 6. Firearm loadouts cover 19 firearm types. Two different modification loadouts are randomly made available each week and refresh every Tuesday at 00:00. Loadouts offered in previous weeks may appear again.
Event Rewards: Elite Gear Ticket, Standard Gear Ticket, Selected Keycard Copy Supply Selection Pack, Keycard Copy Supply Selection Pack, Craftwork Lucky Pack, and various Weekend Select weapons.
● New Firearm
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/9079bdf5173a6b3268345e73aa7819d80951e991.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10

Event Details: The Arsenal just got a major upgrade. The new AN-94 Assault Rifle is now officially available! Use the AN-94 Assault Rifle to complete in-match Kill Missions and earn the Avatar - Breakout and Armament Vouchers.
● Brakkesh Arsenal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/960e3fe9c5c5d23ace8638afb3c26ed20f9a13b1.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: Babel has opened. Dive deep into Brakkesh, where there are plenty of guns and ammo to go around! In tandem with Brakkesh Renewed and the all-new faction clash mode, the Brakkesh major node guide event is launching in full force! During the event, explore the Brakkesh Core Area, take part in faction gameplay, and complete active missions to accumulate milestone progress. Easily unlock Ammo Selection Packs, various tiers of gun packs tailored to the Brakkesh map, Tactical Armament Vouchers, and generous rewards like the Haavk Emblem and Ahsarah Emblem!
● Renewed Recon
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/c0caba24c9d6d08982cd6421abb38c5d0b544dbf.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: Return to the New Tower of Babel! Brakkesh is in turmoil. Shoot, loot, then scoot! During the event, log in daily and complete active missions to accumulate Brakkesh Tokens, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Event Store.
Event Rewards: Brakkesh Token
● Weapon Trial
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/1657d825701508f08631a3e63d6ff51fea21d9f7.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: Weapon Trials are here! During the event, dive into the Brakkesh battlefield, use the specified firearm to complete matches and defeat enemy targets, and earn a large number of Brakkesh Tokens, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Event Store.
Event Rewards: Brakkesh Token
● Shades Bounty
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/6f03b82e4b560e363d1e56d417a1b93af4cc5a5d.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: Become the Shades Hunter! During the event, head to Brakkesh to defeat enemy units and search for captured agent shades to earn Brakkesh Tokens. Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Event Store.
Event Rewards: Brakkesh Token
● Faction Front
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/a944b555a137be89e16045002b58d3e359ab64d1.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: Join a faction and fight for it! During the event, head to Brakkesh to take part in faction clashes. Pick up an Ahsarah or Haavk faction ID Tag in-match and successfully complete any faction's milestone mission to easily earn Brakkesh Token rewards.
Event Rewards: Brakkesh Token
● Hunting Hour
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f05f08a3b775f6d5690d079b7123418697c33cb4.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/26

Event Details: The Hunt Event is open. Sprint toward the ultimate supplies! During the event, dive into the Brakkesh battlefield and complete active missions such as kill tallies and kill challenges to earn Brakkesh Token rewards. Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Event Store.
Event Rewards: Brakkesh Token
● Finale - Win Legendary Firearm Appearance!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/71300fc81b5c685f31c44e3d1d865ad5cd5e00e1.jpg"]Event Time: 11/11 - 12/03

Event Details: The DFI Sweden World Championship is heating up. Join the event predictions to win limited appearance grand prizes! During the event, log in daily to claim tactical supplies and earn betting chances, then place your bets on your favorite team. Watch the finale matches and claim your prizes: correctly predicting a team's advancement to the finals earns you the Vehicle Appearance "Northern Frontier - Assault Vehicle," and predicting the overall champion earns you the Legendary Appearance "Overtime - AK-12"!
● Find Sleepy Zoya
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/e0a8d0348465ce9df8263bcd360c3f611a3e015b.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/23
Event Details: Sleepy Zoya is dropping for a limited time! During the event, Briefcases across all maps have a chance to drop the Collectible - Sleepy Zoya.
● Colorful Sleepy Zoya
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/dfdcf534d3a64e983d21a44ff0d22483c88f57f7.png"]Event Time: 2026/11/10 - 2027/01/25

Event Details: Colorful Sleepy Zoya (Hidden Edition), the rarest collectible of the Reorientation season, is now available! During the event, containers on all maps have a low chance to drop the Hidden Edition - Colorful Sleepy Zoya!
● Collab Limited Red
Event Details: The Phantom Blade Zero Collab Figurine – Soul · Roaming Blade is here! During the event, Bird Nests across all maps have a chance to drop the Collectible - Soul · Roaming Blade.
● Haavk Military Attachments
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/8d38fd96a71e3960815102d7b34ea9dc9163a6ad.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/17

Event Details: New Haavk attachments have arrived! Limited-time attachments for the PKM General Machine Gun Bullpup Kit and HVK Binary Stock Kit are now available. Head to the Auction House to buy them directly, or pick them up with a low drop chance from Large Weapon Crates in-match.
Warfare Events
● Season Challenge

Event Details: The Warfare season-exclusive challenge is live! During the event, complete missions to accumulate points and progressively unlock this season's exclusive firearm and gadget appearances, exclusive badge, avatar, and Calling Card, plus draw for rich rewards like TurBricks!

Event Rewards: M700 Sniper Rifle - Serenity, Claymore Mine - Zero-Grav, Badge - Aurora Operation Commemorative, FSV Wheeled Tank Destroyer - Ahsarah Guard, Avatar - Vehicle Enthusiast, Calling Card - Three-Way Standoff, TurBrick, Tactical Armament Voucher, Aurora Season 2x Merit Card, Aurora Season Merit Protection Card
● New Map[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f4c0d87dd238e49a1a0db8e53dee16b0f0e43cf8.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10
Event Details: Zenith Port is officially live! During the event, head to Warfare to experience the new map Zenith Port, complete active missions, and easily earn Tactical Armament Voucher rewards!
● New Operator
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/109ab9ba4d505f9101fe4afcde061a5726c5cf0f.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10

Event Details: Defend, counterattack, and grow stronger with every battle! New Operator "Martelo" joins the battlefield in full force! Unlock the Pass to get the brand-new Assault Operator Veronica Cardozo for free. Use the new Operator's gadget in-match to complete designated missions and earn Tactical Armament Vouchers and the Calling Card: Taunt.
● New Firearm
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/9079bdf5173a6b3268345e73aa7819d80951e991.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 12/10
Event Details: New firearm AN-94 Assault Rifle has landed in the Arsenal. Complete in-match Kill Missions using the AN-94 Assault Rifle to earn the Avatar - Breakout and Armament Vouchers.
● Battle of Zenith Port
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/c7209ff384668dd4d0c8bdede03ee66bb2ac4fda.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/19

Event Details: During the event, play on the new map "Zenith Port", complete event missions to earn event points, and hit active milestones to unlock rewards like Toro Scatenato - Tank, Premium Weapon EXP Token, and more.
● Haavk Military Attachments
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/8d38fd96a71e3960815102d7b34ea9dc9163a6ad.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/17

Event Details: New Haavk attachments have arrived! Limited-time attachments for the PKM General Machine Gun Bullpup Kit and HVK Binary Stock Kit are now available. Head to the Armory and complete missions to unlock them.
Weekly Events
● Operations Weekly Supplies
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/036c6dbe2160e5fbaab08d5131ab43962a637748.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/19
Event Description: Complete weekly cumulative login events to earn Gear Tickets.
Event Rewards: Standard Gear Tickets, Elite Gear Tickets
● Warfare Weekly Supplies
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/036c6dbe2160e5fbaab08d5131ab43962a637748.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/16
Event Description: Complete weekly cumulative login events to earn a Season Play Choice Pack.
Event Rewards: Season Play Choice Pack
●Weekend Merit Boost
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/6512d0a246e20eb0ff1dc712a28ceb4b918304d3.png"]Event Time: 11/14 - 11/15
Description: During the event, your first three Warfare Grade Matches grant double Merit.
● Expert Choice[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/7121462f309c816b42b197a9d8b86965b49ad9aa.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/16
Event Rules: Complete missions using designated weapons (K437、M250) to claim rewards!
Rewards: Intermediate Weapon EXP Token, Premium Weapon EXP Token, Armament Voucher.
●Tekniq Alloy Store
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/51003ee6fd7dce1f93832ff58fbd2a534d463d33.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/19
Rules: Limited-time Tekniq Alloy shop.
Rewards: Spend Tekniq Alloy to purchase Quantum Keys, Logistics Vouchers and Advanced Secure Container 7-Day Access Card.
● Score Calculation
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/b40b517c75e3d5280ca248df897c82b02329d161.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/19
Event Rules: Play Warfare mode to earn Event Tokens. Tokens can be used to redeem rewards at the Quantum Key Supply.
● Detonation Supply
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/7f4c6dec0d447874df6f2ae75787d5fb9ba66b31.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/16
Event Description: Play Detonation matches to earn rewards such as Armament Vouchers and TurBricks. Missions refresh every Tuesday.
Event Rewards: TurBrick, Armament Voucher
● Damage Calculation
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/c47afc300e3bced7a5130e7db65b4892910c2f81.png"]Event Time: 11/10 - 11/19
Event Description: Accumulate in-match damage in Detonation to earn Event Tokens. Tokens can be used to redeem rewards at the Quantum Key Supply.
Store Updates
● Season Pass
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/68c33fb0a660ba598d2ffb096b39821f7535548e.jpg"]● Season Pass Period: Starting with the November 10 update

● Major rewards include: New Operator - Martelo (unlocked free), Gizmo - Lone Path; Lone Path - MK47; Horoscope - AR57 Assault Rifle, UZI Submachine Gun, MCX LT; Pulse Stalker - SVCH, .357 Revolver, M870 Shotgun; Astronavigation - GTQ-35 Tank; Desert - Respawn Beacon; Season Safe Box (2*2/2*3), TurBrick, a large number of Delta Tickets, Armament Vouchers, massive tactical supplies, Weapon EXP Tokens, and more;
○ Season-exclusive ammo in the \ Ammo Selection Pack Lv.4, \ Ammo Selection Pack Lv.5, and \ Premium Ammo Selection Pack will be updated to the season-exclusive ammo craftable in the current season;
○ Rewards in the "Special Supply Pack" will update with the season. The highest-quality reward this season will change from "Robot Cleaner" to "Prototype Fusion Power Unit";
● Unlock Method: Subject to in-game display

● Operator Research: Raptor - Breath of Thunder[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/634c34efa3a5cff5db5d8e1f9d5ef4dd43e8caef.jpg"]The \[Breath of Thunder] series includes: Raptor - Breath of Thunder Appearance, Breath of Thunder - M700 Sniper Rifle, Breath of Thunder Charm, Watch, Emote, Profile Card, Spray, Voice Lines x3, and Exclusive Execution;
Event Description: Participate using Delta Tickets or Delta Coins. Obtaining the Raptor - Breath of Thunder Appearance will grant all remaining rewards from the current prize pool.
● MandelBrick - Proto Blade
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/53b6d48e0b4f6c028c45def11c9fe4ef662eba9f.jpg"]○ MandelBrick - Proto Blade series is now available! Earn MandelBricks by playing matches!

○ Includes: Proto Blade - K437, Bespoke Design - Desert Eagle, CI-19 Assault Rifle, AUG Assault Rifle; Slumber Party - AR-57 Assault Rifle, FS-12, PKM General Machine Gun, SV-98 Sniper Rifle; Striation - M700 Sniper Rifle, PTR-32 Assault Rifle, M1014 Shotgun, Mini-14 Marksman Rifle; Caution Tape - FS-12, M7 Battle Rifle, Desert Eagle, AKM Assault Rifle, SR-25 Marksman Rifle; Polar Frost - K437, Bizon Submachine Gun, SVD Sniper Rifle, CAR-15 Assault Rifle, M870 Shotgun

○ Previous MandelBricks will not be removed and will continue to drop at reduced rates in the new season. However, MandelBricks from 5+ seasons ago will have extremely low drop rates and become rare drops. After this season's update, Proto Blade will become a rare drop.
○ Drop guarantee progress for different MandelBrick series is independent of each other.
○ Quantum Keys can unlock any MandelBrick series.
○ Older series MandelBricks and their appearances will still be tradable on the Market.

○ Deluxe Collection appearance reconstruction can use appearances from any series as materials. The resulting appearance is randomly generated based on the materials used. Using more materials from the same series increases the chance of obtaining an appearance from that series. Using materials exclusively from the same series guarantees a higher quality appearance from that series.
● Sanguine Series Appearance Lucky Draw
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/33ec33f5229eb46cb3ee0a7d0735b6986e3c508d.jpg"]Event Time: 2026/11/10 - 2027/01/25

Event Details: During the event, each draw grants rewards while building up draw progress. Hitting milestone progress nodes unlocks Sanguine series appearances. At 100% progress, you'll obtain the Sanguine appearance.
Every draw has a chance to instantly jump to 100% progress, unlocking all appearances at once. All event rewards are guaranteed within 90 draws.

Rewards Overview: Sanguine series appearances (Melee Weapon - Sanguine, Sanguine - AKM Assault Rifle, Sanguine - SCAR-H Battle Rifle), plus Sanguine series charm, avatar, Calling Card, spray paint, TurBrick, Weapon EXP Token, and Draw Ticket (usable in firearm and vehicle appearance draw events).
● TurBrick - Asgard

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/4b9d98bde3166b25e59ae4407da8609efd2370ac.jpg"]○ The TurBrick charm series theme has been refreshed to Asgard, with the Hidden Edition Deluxe Charm: Fenrir awaiting you!
○ Your existing TurBricks can still be scanned, and Deluxe Charms can still be traded.

○ Deluxe Charm Reconstruction - Use Charms from different series as materials. The more Charms from the same series, the higher the chance of getting a TurBrick from that series. If all materials are from one series, you'll get a TurBrick from that series.
○ TurBrick Cumulative Scan Rewards: The new season's TurBrick \ adds cumulative scan rewards.
■ Scan to collect the specified number of Legendary Deluxe Charms and unlock the corresponding reward.
■ Scan 1 to get 1x Spray Paint - Asgard;
■ Scan 4 to get 1x Asgard Set Pack (includes Avatar & Calling Card);
■ Scan 8 to get a Deluxe Charm Selection Pack (choose 1 non-Hidden Edition Deluxe Legendary Charm from the current season).
● White Serpent & Crimson Viper Appearance Lucky Draw
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/5f48b4c2f6e70e1984459428821fbb33312d24d7.jpg"]Event Time: 11/13 - 12/12
Event Entry: \ - \[Top Pick] - \[White Serpent & Crimson Viper]
During the event, you can head to the designated entry to participate in a non-replacement draw. The first draw costs only 10 Delta Coins/Delta Tickets.
There are no duplicate rewards in the prize pool. After obtaining all rewards in a single round, the next round draw qualification will automatically unlock.

When you hit the grand prize in any round, you're guaranteed to receive one of the White Serpent & Crimson Viper series appearances, randomly selected. Plus, you'll also get all the other rewards from that round that you hadn't collected yet!

Rewards Overview: White Serpent & Crimson Viper series weapon appearances (K437 Assault Rifle, P90 Submachine Gun, QJB201 Light Machine Gun), series avatar, Calling Card, charm, spray paint, TurBrick - Asgard, Premium Weapon EXP Token.
● New Store Supplies
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f14e3e73fe9bd0284df88f1185f3b089de510247.jpg"]Available from: After the November 10 update until the end of the season
Purchase Entry: \ - \[Special Offer]
Includes: RM277 - Fealty, 60 Delta Coins, Avatar, Spray Paint;
Pack Price: 0.99 USD or equivalent in local currency
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/033ebff8f7412bbc5b0c6237be98bb800961922f.jpg"]Available from: After the November 10 update until the end of the season
Purchase Entry: \ - \[Special Offer]
Includes: PSG-1 Marksman Rifle - Blocking Action, 200 Delta Coins, Avatar, Spray Paint;
Pack Price: 2.99 USD or equivalent in local currency
The main update contents are listed above. Thank you for your attention and support, Operators. Enjoy the game!
Delta Force Team

releases.displayName: Major Update: Season Aurora Is Coming!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f1ef1f52c706459802e49dc23ecb77644fe10088.jpg"]Dear Operators,
We plan to launch a non-stop update for PC, mobile, and console versions on November 10, opening the new season "Aurora"!
The expected update cadence for the PC version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on November 10, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on November 10, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on November 10, the PC update will be available.
Tip: If you encounter any issues after the update, try restarting the game to complete the update.
The expected update cadence for the mobile version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on November 10, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on November 10, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on November 10, the Android and iOS updates will be available.
Tip: iOS users should upgrade their system version to 13 or higher.
The expected update cadence for the console version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on November 10, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on November 10, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on November 10, the updates for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 will be available.

notes.title: Here are the main contents of the new season

items.text: New Assault Operator, Martelo; Brakkesh 2.0: major map updates; a new mode for AZ3, Supercritical; a new Warfare map, Zenith Port; the new firearm, AN-94 Assault Rifle; new ammo and Attachments; plus a wide range of optimizations and balance adjustments!
Full details on this season's update are below. Dive in!
New Operator
● New Assault Operator: Veronica Cardozo, Code Name: Martelo
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/109ab9ba4d505f9101fe4afcde061a5726c5cf0f.png"]○ Ariete

Martelo deploys the Ariete and charges forward continuously. Damage taken from the front is reduced during the charge, and it ends upon colliding with an enemy or wall, triggering a Heavy Strike that damages and knocks down enemies in range. Martelo can also end the charge early by leaping and slamming the Ariete into the ground ahead, dealing damage and knocking down enemies in range.
○ Smoke Halo

Fires multiple smoke grenades from a shoulder-mounted launcher around the operator, creating a halo of smoke upon detonation. Hold to enter single-shot mode, then release after selecting a target location to fire a smoke grenade that creates a full smokescreen covering the entire area.
○ High-Explosive Grenade
Quickly throws a high-explosive grenade forward. The grenade begins a detonation countdown after being thrown and explodes after a few seconds.
○ Guerreira
The fiercer the battle, the more Martelo's fighting spirit grows. Knocking down an enemy or dropping below a certain HP threshold briefly increases movement speed and reload speed.
Map Update
● Operations Map Update: Brakkesh
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/960e3fe9c5c5d23ace8638afb3c26ed20f9a13b1.png"]"Haavk Corp and the Ahsarah Guard are going head-to-head. Who will you fight for? Choose your side!"
● New Warfare Map: Zenith Port

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f4c0d87dd238e49a1a0db8e53dee16b0f0e43cf8.png"]"With covering fire from the fleet, G.T.I. forces storm Zenith Port. As the battle for the beach intensifies, the Intel Department's warnings about the unstable seabed go unheeded."
○ Riptide Event

A sustained barrage of guided missiles draws fire from the air defenses, triggering the Riptide event. Intercepted missiles explode in the sea, unleashing huge waves that transform the battlefield and create a new attack-and-defense experience centered on rooftop tactics!
● AZ3 - Supercritical
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/0a16936b09f200aee5162150f6dc736d6c5c010b.png"]"Contamination is spreading! Evacuate the affected area immediately!"

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/478cb2118e8b909338e9e59c011b6c3113cceb9a.png"]Gameplay Tuning
In-Game Combat & Level Improvements
All Modes
○ On mobile, press the slot for your equipped firearm again to switch directly to your melee weapon.
○ Improved the balance of certain hit reaction animations.
○ After dragging another character, players now return to a standing position instead of crouching.
● Improved kill feedback: enemies now have a wider range of reactions when defeated.
● Improved character animation: weapons slung on characters' backs now respond to movement with physics-based motion.
Warfare
● Enhanced character animation
○ Improved character physics for more varied reactions to weapon and explosive damage.
○ Improved character animations when interacting with certain parts of the environment.
○ TV-Guided Missiles can now be intercepted and destroyed mid-flight.
○ Wheeled Tank Destroyers can now maintain relatively high movement speed after their engine is destroyed.
○ Reduced the flight speed of the UCB-95 Assault Boat's Wire-Guided Missile.
○ The Amphibious LSV's flamethrower now heats up faster while firing and cools down faster after firing stops.
○ Narrowed the area in which the LAV-G1 IFV's guided missiles can lock onto targets. Maximum lock-on distance is unchanged.
○ Added a chat notification when an enemy vehicle is hacked using a freeze gadget.

notes.title: ○ Amphibious LSV modification point cost adjustments

items.text: ■ Variant modification cost: 5,000 → 4,000 points
■ Reduced the point cost of the mortar modification and ammo resupply by 500 each.
■ Reduced the point cost of the rocket launcher modification and ammo resupply by 500 each.
Amphibious vehicles and watercraft now rise and fall with the waves. Currently available only on Zenith Port.
Disrupting an enemy vehicle with tactical gear now displays a score notification, grants an assist if the vehicle is destroyed, and automatically alerts your side.
● Added collision checks to Coastal Artillery in the Free Build system to prevent shells from passing through obstacles.
● Improved placement logic for the Free Build system.
● Increased the assist points earned by transport helicopter pilots to 120.
● Fixed issues with certain battle areas in Threshold - King of the Hill.
● Adjusted the defenders' LAV-AA deployment location in Sector A of Cyclone in Victory Unite and Attack and Defend.
● Adjusted certain locations in The Mog to improve balance.
● Improved the travel route of the Black Hawk convoy in The Mog.
\[Detonation (Bomb Defusal Mode)]
● Improved the map layout to address cramped spaces, excessive corners, and difficulty rotating back to defend. Reduced the distance at which the Power Station zipline can be heard.
● Improved how players request gear on the purchase screen.
● Improved helmet and ballistic vest purchases: when one is undamaged, you can now buy the other separately.
● Improved the NC8's visual effects, making its pulsing indicator light easier to see.
● Improved the bomb site indicator.
● Added a display for helmet and ballistic vest durability.
● Improved the bomb planting and defusing UI.
● Made it clearer whether you are attacking or defending.
● Fixed an issue where firing as a round ended could cause the weapon to keep firing at the start of the next round.
● Fixed the issue where operator gadget status was displayed incorrectly while spectating.
● The scoreboard now ranks players by actual damage dealt, excluding damage beyond the amount needed to defeat a target.
● Improved in-match voice announcements.
● Improved the accuracy of AFK detection.
● Players can now equip certain tactical gadgets during the preparation phase and line up their aim.
System Optimization
All Modes
● Feedback System: Players can now upload images and videos when reporting issues on PC.
● Voice System: Improved how incoming voice volume is handled for a better listening experience.
● 1v1 Voice Chat: Added voice chat in rooms and matches. Select the Squad Up or Squad chat channel to join the corresponding voice channel.
● Chat System: Updated emote art style and expanded the emote selection.
● Player Activity: Players can now choose which emote to react with.

● Custom Mode Room Codes: Sharing a room code for 1v1, Free Battlefield, or Detonation in chat now displays a message identifying the mode. The message includes "Copy" and "Quick Join" buttons to copy the code or join the room.
○ Genius Ratty: In a single Operations match, find red collectibles occupying at least 24 slots in previously unopened containers, then extract successfully. (Dark Matter Fuel excluded)

○ One More Can: In Warfare, destroy a high-value vehicle within 30 seconds of it appearing in a match. Do this twice in total. (Victory Unite matches only; Assault Vehicles, ATVs, and Light Tactical Vehicles excluded)
○ Pro Hunter: Win a Detonation match with an average of 2 enemy operator kills per round. (Match must be fully completed; surrender or terminated matches do not count)
● Honor Insignias: Improved their appearance in the Name Card preview window.
Operations
● The Operations map rotation for the new season is as follows:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/e78314a1154cd9b9f1ea7de60419ca7a76badbe8.jpg"]● Loading Plans added to Gunsmith and Loadout: Unlocks at Operations Level 35. Go to Gunsmith - Plans - Loading Plan to set the ammo sequence for your current weapon, including the rounds at the top of the magazine and the repeating sequence in the middle. Apply saved plans from the Loadout screen, or switch between them in a match using the radial menu.
● Optimized the display of meds and ammo in Quick Equip: stash quantities are now prioritized.

● Black Site Facility Visibility: If you have not unlocked the Decon Chamber, complete one AZ3 match to unlock it. If you have not unlocked the Diving Center, reach Operations Level 33 to unlock it. Already unlocked facilities are unaffected.
● Use Ammo Selection Packs directly from Loadout: If your Stash does not contain enough of the selected ammo, choose "Exchange" to open an Ammo Selection Pack and obtain the ammo you need.
● Loadout Plan Improvements: You can now set default helmet and ballistic vest durability in loadout plans. The save plan popup also includes a "Delete" button for removing saved plans.
● Fish Exchange at the Bazaar: Once you unlock the fishing mode, you can trade your catch for items at the Bazaar.
● Bazaar Preview: View the materials required for the next exchange cycle starting 3 days before the Bazaar refreshes.
● Chroma Collectible Quality: Added a new Chroma quality tier. Existing Chroma collectibles will move from Red to Chroma quality.
○ Red Quality: Plasma Cutter, Neutron Detector, Queen Piece
○ Gold Quality: Nuclear Battery
○ Purple Quality: External Data Card
● Added inspection animations for high-value items: Round Sky & Square Earth, Laptop, Renowned Kiln Porcelain, and Reactor Cooling Core.
● Gear Ticket Updates: Gear Ticket loadouts are being revised to offer more equipment combinations and more ways to play.
○ Season Mission Custom Gear Ticket
■ (Option 1): Removed MK4 Submachine Gun, K416 Assault Rifle, and Thompson SMG; added M14 Marksman Rifle, M250 Light Machine Gun, and SR-25 Marksman Rifle.
■ (Option 2): Removed ASh-12 Battle Rifle; added PKM Light Machine Gun.
○ Spec Ops Gear Ticket
■ (Balanced): Removed ASh-12 Battle Rifle; added AR-57 Assault Rifle.
■ (Survival): Removed SVCH Marksman Rifle; added MDR Assault Rifle.
■ (Firepower): Removed MK4 Submachine Gun; added SR-25 Marksman Rifle. In the M700 Sniper Rifle loadout, replaced 93R with MP5 Submachine Gun.
○ Elite Gear Ticket
■ (Balanced): Removed QJB201 Light Machine Gun and MK4 Submachine Gun; added MCX LT Assault Rifle and AN-94 Assault Rifle.
■ (Firepower): Removed Lever-action Rifle; added M700 Sniper Rifle
Warfare

● Added shortcuts in the Lobby to make 2x Merit Cards and Merit Protection Cards easier to use.
● Players with fewer than 6 Victory Unite matches played must now confirm again when running for Commander in that mode.
● On mobile, players must now press the button to run for Commander in Victory Unite.
● Added bonus points for holding objectives as the attacking side in Victory Unite. When defenders contest an objective the attackers have captured, attackers earn extra points for clearing them out.

● Added Thermobaric Bomb to Call-in Attack: Throw a strike beacon to mark the target. The bomb penetrates every obstacle in its path to reach that location. On impact, it creates a small lethal shockwave and releases combustible dust. After a brief delay, the dust detonates, dealing burn damage over a wide area.

● New options for vehicle airdrops in Call-in Attack: Spend points to add extra effects to an airdrop. Currently, this can provide certain vehicles with temporary active defense protection during the airdrop.
● New Immersive Mode: In Warfare on PC, go to Settings - Screen - Warfare Mode to enable Immersive Mode. It hides most of the UI for a more immersive battlefield experience.
*Applies only to Attack and Defend, King of the Hill, and Victory Unite.

items.text: Powered by UE5, global illumination (Lumen), geometry (Nanite), virtual shadow maps (VSM), water, and vegetation are rendered at higher quality.

items.text: Improves gunfire, footsteps, explosions, ambient sound, spatial audio, and the overall mix. Toggle it in Settings to apply it immediately, even during a match. Currently available only on Zenith Port; other modes and maps are unaffected.

notes.title: The main content of this update includes

items.text: Operations Map Rotation Adjustments
● AZ3 - Normal is now permanently available.
Warfare Balance Adjustments
○ Adjusted the deployment point locations for the Sector B and Sector C phases;
○ Adjusted the boundary and combat area of Sector C;
○ Reduced the number of Deployment Bases above the attacking team's position in Sector C;
○ C2 has been changed to a Secondary Objective;
■ Reduced the damage dealt to the convoy by anti-vehicle mines, Guided Missiles, and Artillery Barrages;
■ Slightly increased convoy movement speed;
■ Adjusted checkpoint time allocation for Escort the Convoy: the initial time is now 4 minutes and 30 seconds, with 45 seconds added at each checkpoint;
■ Slightly reduced the distance between the attacking team's deployment points and the convoy;
■ Adjusted the defending team's Deployment Base locations in Phase 2.
Hudson's Surge Squad Balance Adjustments
● Added more vulnerable moments to Surge Squad behavior, including during reloads, turns, and between firing bursts;
● Removed Surge Squad's ability to lock onto targets through walls.
Bug Fixes & Optimizations
● Map feature now unlocks at Operations Level 4;
● Fixed an issue where the Armory in Warfare did not display new weapons from the current season;
● Fixed an issue where players could occasionally get stuck at the C1 deployment point on The Mog;
● Fixed incorrect text in some seasonal missions;
● Fixed an occasional issue where reloading is not normal;
● Fixed an issue where duplicate highlight notifications could appear in Social - Player Activity;
● Fixed an issue where scores could display incorrectly in Team Deathmatch - The Mog at the end of a match;
● Fixed an issue where an enemy's Death Box could occasionally disappear after they were defeated;
● Fixed an issue where players could occasionally become stuck after being attacked by Clover;
● Fixed an issue with the durability of Fishing Lines obtained during a match;
● Reduced the number of required completions for Phase 1 of Taj Faris's mission in Layali Grove. It now only needs to be completed once;
● Fixed an issue where mission items in Taj Faris's mission could occasionally not be interacted with;
● Optimized the success criteria for Zola's mission, The Breeze Still Blows;
● Added a dialogue prompt from Joe Reed to the Fishing system: Fishing unlocks at Operations Level 17;
● Fixed an issue where the requirements for some fishing missions did not match their actual objectives;
● Fixed an issue where items could not be dragged in the Stash and Backpack interfaces when using a controller;
● Fixed an issue with incorrect directionality for rescue audio;
● Fixed an issue where the location of Reis's Lost Hero's Helmet could display incorrectly;
● Fixed an occasional issue where the view through a sight could display incorrectly using ADS;
● Fixed an issue where interactions could behave abnormally during Emergency Shutdown;
● Fixed an issue where framerate fluctuations could cause vehicle movement to stutter;
● Fixed an issue where tokens could not be exchanged consecutively in Weekend Select;
● Fixed an issue with the customization of random melee weapons.
The main update contents are listed above. Thank you for your attention and support, Operators. Enjoy the game!
Delta Force Team

"Raptor can build information advantage for the team and control the pace of the battlefield, but the way information and disruption gadgets can be chained together in quick succession currently leaves opponents with too little room to maneuver. We want Raptor players to be more deliberate about when to deploy these gadgets, while giving opponents more room to respond. We also want both sides of a fight to be able to gather information from Wing Cam, creating two-way mind games. We'll continue monitoring Raptor's post-adjustment performance and follow up based on data and feedback."

-Fixed an issue where the Switch Point alarm sound played abnormally after reconnecting;

-Fixed an issue where the LAV-AA would lose its hit sound effects;
-Fixed an issue where the Sineva - Montagne appearance would occasionally not display properly on mobile versions;
-Fixed an issue where the lobby interface would occasionally display abnormally on mobile versions;
-Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally get stuck at the Black Site after launch on console versions.
Scheduled Fix for 7/17
-Fixed an issue where some bulletproof glass in the Old Academy of Sciences in AZ3 would incorrectly disappear;
-Fixed an issue in Warfare where applying a vehicle appearance during a match could cause active ability effects to persist;
-Fixed an issue where some nuclear facilities in AZ3 could be seen through before activation.

Delta Force Team

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/6e1f027e5d714d557f26fa3e86e047c79a89a9e2.jpg"]Dear Operators,

We've been following the community's conversations around combat balance: too many gadgets in active fights, information being exposed too easily, and tactical tools leaving less room for gunplay. We hear you.
With this announcement, we want to share how we're thinking about these issues and where our next balance changes are headed.

Operator gadgets are meant to be one way to create and execute tactics. They should work alongside gunplay, not replace it. Our goal is for each Operator to bring a distinct tactical identity while still keeping firefights readable, fair, and exciting.

Over the past few updates, several new Operators have joined the roster: Gizmo, built around single-lane defense; N-Two, focused on map control and forward pressure; Raptor, capable of flexible reconnaissance across different situations; and Morse, who excels in fast-paced skirmishes. These Operators were designed to open up new tactical choices and new ways to combine abilities with gunplay.
As their playstyles have developed, however, some abilities have started to push beyond healthy counterplay.

Control gadgets with complex routes can leave opponents with limited ways to evade or respond. One-sided information tools can also shut down carefully planned tactical decisions too easily. When players are forced to process too many gadget-driven threats at once, fights become harder to read, counterplay becomes less clear, and defeats can feel more frustrating than they should.

This update is aimed at bringing those interactions back into a healthier state. After reviewing match data and player feedback, we're adjusting areas where counterplay is unclear or frustration is too high. The goal is to give players more reasonable ways to respond while preserving each Operator's core tactical role.
After the changes go live, we'll continue monitoring match data and feedback, and make further adjustments when needed.

Over the next few weeks, we'll be adjusting multiple Operators whose current gameplay impact has moved beyond our intended boundaries. We want combat decisions to feel clearer, counterplay to feel more reasonable, and firefights to return to a healthier balance.
This week, we're starting with Gizmo.
Please keep sharing your feedback. We'll be watching closely.

Below are the main highlights of the 7/10 no-downtime update. Gameplay and matchmaking will not be affected during the update. If you encounter any issues after the update, please restart the game to complete the update. If your game client is out of date, you'll need to update to the latest version to log in.
Operator Balance Adjustments
【Operator - Gizmo】

“When suppressed by multiple Crawlers, it can be difficult to fight back effectively through gunplay, creating more pressure than intended in certain scenarios. This adjustment is designed to reduce the combat pressure of facing multiple Crawlers while fully preserving Gizmo’s standard gameplay experience.”
All Modes
Crawler Nest: Added a new mechanic: Crawler Corrosion Damage Resistance

After taking damage from 3 Crawlers in quick succession, players will gain Corrosion Damage Resistance for a period of time. While the resistance is active, explosion damage taken from Crawlers will be greatly reduced.
Console Bug Fixes
●Fixed an issue where some console models could occasionally crash.
The main update contents are listed above. Thank you for your attention and support, Operators. Enjoy the game!
Delta Force Team

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/3a1035ae6070d3702263cfbe4fe7f4ea405df52b.jpg"]Dear Operators,
We're rolling out a no-downtime update for PC, mobile, and console on June 30 to launch our brand-new season: Meltdown!

After the update is complete, jump into the game to explore all the new "Meltdown" season modes and content, and grab some incredible rewards! If you run into any issues after updating, try restarting the game to finish things up.

notes.title: The main content of this update includes

items.text: Event in Both Modes
● New Season Sign-in
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/9357dc6f82d3fd13a7655370e49f2fa2e087170a.png"]Event time: 6/30~7/12

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/3e616fe049c9fc54dbe4215011cb71e3fe58965d.png"]Event time: 6/30~9/7

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/2f161ef65bacc1c893203d9468de8847300fb3d9.png"]Event time: 6/30~7/30

Event details: A new season ignites! Operations gets a sweeping, game-changing overhaul. The new warzone is full of uncertainty. Deadly threats and classified intel await only the most elite extraction squads.

During the event, venture deep into the Unknown Restricted Zone and complete the "New Season Content" Mission series to earn Season EXP. Head to the Token Store to exchange it for free and claim a massive haul of season-themed Supplies, including Operator Action: Snowfall, Limited Spray Paint: Cool Down, Exclusive Calling Card: Permafrost Pacification, Firearm Appearance: G3 - Purr Baby, and Limited Name Card: Zero Degrees!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/c22e7df51a1fcdf2d3fd7d5b65b8d368ba1e3875.jpg"]Dear Operators, We plan to release a non-stop update for PC version on June 30, launching the new season "Meltdown," the biggest update of the year!
The expected update cadence for the PC version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on June 30, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on June 30, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on June 30, the PC update will be available.

Reminder: This PC update requires downloading 33.5 GB of content; the Steam update package is approximately 57.3 GB. If you encounter any issues after the update, try restarting the game to complete the update.
The expected update cadence for the mobile version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on June 30, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on June 30, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on June 30, the Android and iOS updates will be available.
The expected update cadence for the console version is as follows:
At 00:30 UTC+0 on June 30, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed.
At 01:59 UTC+0 on June 30, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled.
At 02:00 UTC+0 on June 30, the updates for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 will be available.

notes.title: Here are the main contents of the new season

items.text: New Engineer Operator — N-Two, new Operations map — AZ3 the nuclear power plant, new Warfare map — Coliseum; new vehicles; new loadouts; new Operations features; new systems in Black Site; all-new weapons and ammo, plus plenty of QoL optimizations!
Full details on this season's update are below. Dive in!
NEW OPERATOR
Engineer Operator: Gabriel Mercier, Code Name: N-Two
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/80de020a44847c7e8d33a2bf1a348a396f50dcf3.jpg"]●Frost Launcher
Temporarily equip a launcher that can fire up to six frost grenades. Grenades explode on impact, dealing damage and freezing enemies. Consecutive shots increase fire rate.
●Cryo-Flask
Throw a frost canister that releases freezing gas on impact, forming a subzero zone. Enemies inside continuously accumulate freeze effects and cough violently. Can also freeze closed doors.
●Homing Stun Grenade
Throw an auto-tracking stun grenade that disrupts enemy vision and deals damage.
●Frost Effect (Operations)
Low temperature gradually slows enemy movement until they are completely frozen. In Operations, reduces enemy fracture resistance.
● Freeze Buildup (Warfare)
Low temperature gradually slows enemy movement until they are completely frozen. In Warfare, reduces vehicle handling.
Operation
New Map—AZ3 Nuclear Plant
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/a1aab129ee782d32d5e9df021293736dfd80c445.jpg"]● Added Operations new map: AZ3 Nuclear Plant;
● Easy and Normal Operations will be hosted here. Normal Operation entry cost: 112,500 Tekniq Alloys.
● Entering leak zones and searching radiation containers builds up radiation exposure, which affects your character.
New Boss—Neural Device Agent H1000 (AZ3 Nuclear Plant)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/e02710164494dd636facda29774c70a8e10f61a4.jpg"]● Neural Device Agents lurk deep within the core facilities of AZ3 Nuclear Plant. Outfitted with Neural Devices and jacked into Skynet, they are fast, lethal, and unpredictable. Approach with extreme caution.
Warfare
New Map
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/fa00dcd7aa3c560b2d68b64f5b6b3f07a69104eb.jpg"]● Major Event—Two Branches:
○ Stray Thunder: The Haavk rocket is intercepted by a missile, and the resulting debris rains down on the city of Claudia;
○ Thunderstrike: The Haavk rocket is not intercepted and crashes directly into the Coliseum, where both sides clash in a final showdown.
New Vehicle
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/981f61920c2670ad93276e07adb993690423e69f.jpg"]● Added CSV-35 Transport Helicopter;

● A tiltrotor aircraft that combines helicopter vertical takeoff capability with fixed-wing flight speed. It can rapidly deploy combat personnel to target locations, and its modifiable weapon systems give it respectable self-defense capabilities.
New Weapon
● Added RM277 Assault Rifle, using 6.8x51mm caliber ammo;
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/86e5b69deff283c42b5bd101c2baa0242fc9e4a5.jpg"]● Added SVCH Marksman Rifle, using 7.62x54Rmm caliber ammo.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/00482273097c71cbb71b205488ead6f7e5537516.jpg"]New Ammo & New Attachments
New Ammo
● Added 5.8x42mm DVC12+P Season Limited Ammo
○ Overpressure ammo with Level 5 penetration;
○ Hitting enemy operators slows them and increases their hit flinch;
○ Reduces weapon recoil and improves stability when this ammo is loaded.
● Added 5.8x42mm DBP10+P Season Limited Ammo
○ Overpressure ammo with Level 4 penetration;
○ Hitting enemy operators slows them and increases their hit flinch;
○ Reduces weapon recoil and improves stability when this ammo is loaded.
● Added 9x19mm CT Ammo
○ Ammo with Level 0 penetration;
○ Deals 1.75x damage to limbs (i.e., base limb damage × 1.75);
○ Adds random ADS spread and reduces recoil control when this ammo is loaded;
○ Cannot be stored in a Safe Box.
● Added .45 ACP CT Ammo
○ Ammo with Level 0 penetration;
○ Deals 1.6x damage to limbs (i.e., base limb damage × 1.6);
○ Adds random ADS spread and reduces recoil control when this ammo is loaded;
○ Cannot be stored in a Safe Box.
● Added 6.8x51mm PLY-I Ammo
○ Level 3 penetration;
○ Armor Penetration Multiplier: 0.9x;
○ Max stack size per slot: 90 rounds;
○ Improves recoil control when firing continuously.
● Added 6.8x51mm PLY-II Ammo
○ Level 4 penetration;
○ Armor Penetration Multiplier: 0.9x;
○ Max stack size per slot: 90 rounds;
○ Improves recoil control when firing continuously.
● Added 6.8x51mm PLY-III Ammo
○ Level 5 penetration;
○ Armor Penetration Multiplier: 0.9x;
○ Max stack size per slot: 90 rounds;
○ Improves recoil control when firing continuously.
● Added 9x39mm PAB-7 Ammo
○ Level 3 penetration;
○ Hitting an enemy applies a 3-second vulnerability effect to the struck body part, increasing damage taken to that area from subsequent hits;
○ Damage bonus to a single body part caps at 60%.
● Added 9x39mm PAB-9 Ammo
○ Level 4 penetration;
○ Hitting an enemy applies a 3-second vulnerability effect to the struck body part, increasing damage taken to that area from subsequent hits;
○ Damage bonus to a single body part caps at 60%.
New Attachments
● Added Compound Bow Frameless Sight
○ Provides a clean sight picture;
■ Handling: -2.
New Limited-Time Haavk Weapon Attachments
● SVCH Swiftwind Dual Mag
■ Handling: -4;
■ Capacity per mag: 20 rounds;
■ Added a fast reload method.
● Compound Bow HVK Speed Magazine
■ Handling: -4;
■ Mag capacity: 6 rounds;
■ Fire Rate increase: 182 rpm → 227 rpm.
■ Handling: -4;
■ Mag capacity: 6 rounds;
■ Fire Rate increase: 182 rpm → 227 rpm.
● ASh-12 Battle Rifle HVK Binary Trigger Kit
○ Fires two rounds simultaneously per trigger pull;
○ Supports trajectory offset calibration;
■ Damage Specialization: 42;
■ Armor Penetration Specialization: 45;
■ Control: +8;
■ Handling: -2;
■ Hip Fire Accuracy: +8;
■ Fire Rate reduction: 500 rpm → 400 rpm.
○ Warfare
■ Damage Specialization: 30;
■ Control: +6;
■ Handling: -2;
■ Hip Fire Accuracy: +8.
■ Fire Rate reduction: 500 rpm → 400 rpm.
New Black Site System: Decontamination Chamber
● Provides increased radiation resistance and natural radiation decay.
○ Level 1 effect: Radiation tolerance: Weak → Normal, Radiation natural decay kicks in earlier: 15s → 10s;
○ Level 2 effect: Radiation tolerance: Normal → Strong; Radiation natural decay is faster: +0 → +20%;
○ Level 3 effect: Radiation tolerance: Strong → Very Strong; Radiation natural decay kicks in earlier: 10s → 5s; Radiation natural decay is faster: +20% → +50%.
● Operations Level 9 unlocks Decontamination Chamber Tier 1, Level 14 unlocks Tier 2, and Level 27 unlocks Tier 3.
Season Mission System Update

● S9 Season Mission Reset: All progress on Season 9 missions will be completely reset and cleared. Any Ultimate Safe Box Season Access from previous seasons, along with any Safe Box Trial Cards (used or not), will expire and become invalid.
● S10 Season Mission Update: Season 10 kicks off with a brand-new mission line for operators to challenge.

● Added Season Mission Investigation Board: As players work through the Season Mission main storyline, they will steadily uncover intel surrounding the major events at AZ3 Nuclear Plant, building out an investigation board. Players can visit the Investigation Board at any time to check their progress and review gathered materials.
● S10 Season Mission Choice: In the Season Mission main storyline, the fate of AZ3 Nuclear Plant's core facilities will play out differently depending on each Operator's choices...
○ Depending on the choice made in the final mission, the S10 Season Mission badge will come in 2 distinct styles;
○ Operators can only obtain 1 badge based on their choice;
○ Badge styles and names are for Operators to discover for themselves in-game.
○ Badge silhouettes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/f7d43b855a894233f24fea2716ca7771f1a0da73.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/b33f11e2e71fbe7f8fbafde1f94fa1b989aea0b2.png"]● S10 Season Ultimate Safe Box Deluxe Collection Appearance:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/ef42b45eb3736db6de86d3d4f6d0b0064816a887.png"]
In-Game Combat & Level Improvements
All Modes
○ Added relevant Operator voice lines when using markers to request squadmate skills;
○ Fixed jitter and pulling issues when mantling;
○ Improved logic for entering the prone position;
○ Improved the pose when holding a chainsaw melee weapon while prone;
○ Improved reload and weapon-switching performance while prone;
○ Improved water surface interaction effects for characters;
○ Fixed stuttering issues when characters fall in certain situations;
● Fixed occasional visual anomalies in the Firing Range (e.g., missing bullet holes, lingering effect residue);
● Fixed an issue where the MK4 Deep Space Chrome Barrel's actual range stat did not match the stat shown in the panel;
● Fixed an issue where the AR57 Nightingale Suppressed Integral Barrel displayed abnormal visual effects when firing;
● Improved the 1P-33 2/4x Scope's compatibility; it can now be used on more weapons;
● Improved the VMX Frameless Sight's compatibility; it can now be fitted on the AR57 Assault Rifle and as an upper secondary sight on select high-magnification scopes;
● Fixed an issue where the OE2 Combat Stimulant occasionally failed to restore Stamina.
Operations
○ Automatic weapons now come equipped with the Blinding Flashlight munition;
○ Added Set options for the AR57 Assault Rifle, M82 Sniper Rifle, MCX LT Assault Rifle, and MK4 Submachine Gun;
○ Added Stamina Injectors to each loadout to improve Operator mobility on select maps.
● The M82 Sniper Rifle can now deal damage to Chariot-type vehicle equipment in Operations mode.
● Improved Medical Item recommendation logic; added Injector recommendation logic.
Warfare
● Attack and Defend Mode New Mechanic: Secondary Objective
○ After attackers capture a secondary objective, holding it for 60 seconds without defenders recapturing it allows attackers to redeploy there;
○ Secondary objective ownership does not affect overall sector capture progress;
○ Currently applicable sectors: Coliseum Objective B, Objective D; Monument Objective D.
● Warfare Scene Optimization: Environmental Burning
○ On PC, all vegetation and certain objects on Warfare maps can now be ignited, dealing damage and spreading fire within a set radius;
○ Currently applicable maps: Coliseum;
○ More maps will be added in future updates.

○ Akh Canal - A/D & Victory Unite: The Assault Vehicle added for attackers in Sector B when low on Troop Force has been replaced with a CSV-35 Transport Helicopter; one Assault Vehicle has been removed from the defenders in Sector D and replaced with one LAV-AA;
○ Fault - A/D: Adjusted the initial deploy position of the attackers' ground vehicle in Sector A; the attackers' Assault Helicopter in Sector B has been replaced with a CSV-35 Transport Helicopter;
○ Ascension - A/D: Added a score-based CSV-35 Transport Helicopter for both attackers and defenders in Sector D.
○ Adjusted the attackers' redeployment zone in Sector B to prevent players from spawning inside concrete barriers and getting stuck;
○ Airdrops cannot be called in while on the Sector C rooftop.
○ Performance Optimization: Optimized artillery shell visual effects in Sector B on PC to improve frame rate performance;
○ Attack and Defend: Adjusted the combat zone at the Sector B hilltop to ease pressure on attackers.
○ Added a secondary objective to Sector D, opening up more routes and footholds for attackers.
● Added Fixed Weapons: Vulcan Cannon, Auto Vulcan Cannon;
○ The Auto Vulcan Cannon targets enemy aircraft within range; the closer the target, the higher the attack efficiency;
○ The Vulcan Cannon will replace some existing 30mm AA Guns on current maps.
● New Vehicle—CSV-35 Transport Helicopter: The CSV-35 Transport Helicopter is now available for deployment on select maps.

System Optimization
All Modes
● Increased the number of Operators available for selection at account creation;
● Tutorial: Added a system gameplay tutorial;

● Lobby Emotes: Added interactive emote functionality to the Squad lobby—play Operator animations and sync them with squadmates in real time; added a new entry point next to the chat emoji button (Shortcut: F2);

○ G.T.I. Superman: In a Normal AZ3 Nuclear Plant match, eliminate 7 enemy Operators in a single match while under maximum radiation exposure;

○ Added the Deluxe Charm Cabinet system, accessible via Collectibles > Owned Deluxe Charms; any Deluxe Charm can be displayed in the cabinet;

Operations
● Map Rotation: The Operations map rotation for the new season is as follows.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050610/b6f1ad0f55d27a7fe6737fa73f8ee16f8dd8b66a.jpg"]● Black Site: Reduced the crafting cost of .50 BMG caliber ammo;

Delta Force Team

New Engineer Operator: Gizmo, New Warfare Map: Monument, New Operations Mini-Mode: Sinkpoint Dam, New Hot Zone Maps, New MK4 Submachine Gun, New Ammo, New Consumables, New Syringes, Season Mission System improvements, extensive gameplay optimizations and bug fixes.
● New Engineer Operator: Rashid Rahal, Codename: Gizmo
Operator Role: Engineer
Operator Trait - Firewall: When positioned near one of his deployables, he receives a buff that improves weapon handling speed.

Tactical Gear - Crawler Nest: Deploys a mechanical nest containing three crawlers. The crawlers track enemies and explode on proximity, dealing damage and applying corrosion that increases the bullet damage enemies take. Corroded enemies will be marked in Smart Smoke.

Gadget - Smoke Mine: Deploys smart smoke that sticks to hard surfaces. The smoke activates when enemies approach and slows anyone who enters it. Corroded enemies will be marked when they enter the Smart Smoke.

Gadget - T.I.M (Tenacious Interception Module): Throws a self-propelled mechanical T.I.M that patrols in the designated direction. When it detects enemies during patrol, it hunts them down and fires a restraining net that severely limits mobility, prevents ADS, and disables operator gadget usage. If enemies are corroded, the T.I.M will track them immediately.
How to Unlock: Available through the free Season Pass tier.
The once-thriving ancient city of Ahsarah, now lies in ruins, devastated by meteorological weapons and war. Haavk has occupied the empty shell of what was once a vibrant metropolis,
Three-round burst for instant enemy elimination!
● New Mini-Mode: Zero Dam-Sinkpoint

Unexpected flooding has occurred in the underground pipeline area of Zero Dam. In desperation, Sayid has planted massive amounts of explosives at key facilities—the crisis has reached a breaking point!
Opening Time
Zero Dam - Sinkpoint Operation Entry Value: 112,500 Tekniq Alloys
Zero Dam - Sinkpoint Operation will occasionally feature Dusk weather with unique visual and audio effects.
Zero Dam - Sinkpoint Operation adds ladders for entering the underground pipeline area, making access to the Pipeline Area more convenient. Other Zero Dam modes remain unaffected.
New Operation - Operation Defuser: Accept the mission to defuse bombs and receive airdrop supply rewards upon completion.
Saeed has assembled his elite guard to patrol the Dam Interior. Saeed is now more aggressive—proceed with caution!
● New Hot Zone Maps
Added six new maps: Zero Dam AC, Space City Core Area, Tide Prison Core Area, Layali Grove Sparkling Empress Hotel, Brakkesh Market, and Brakkesh New Tower of Babel Top Floor.
Hot Zone now allows active map selection, with a minimum of three maps required.
● Tide Prison - Hard

Map Adjustments: Extraction points now have an overload mechanism, allowing only 5 people to extract at a time. When more than 5 people are at the extraction point, evacuation priority is determined by order of entry into the extraction zone. Relevant prompts will appear when overload prevents extraction.
Affected extraction points: Helicopter Landing Area extraction point, Pipeline Gate 1/2/3 extraction points.
● New Consumables & New Syringes
○ Proteus Jammer: Season-exclusive consumable that reduces enemy soldier alertness for 45 seconds after use.

The latest full-spectrum IFF signal jammer developed by G.T.I.'s technical department. When activated, this device automatically broadcasts communication signals with friendly characteristics, effectively disrupting specific targets' reconnaissance and search capabilities.

○ Tactical Gear Supply: Speeds up Tactical Gear recharge after use. Uluru, Shepherd, Tempest: Reduces Tactical Gear cooldown by 15%. Stinger: Restores two Hive-Tech Pistol rounds. Other operators: Reduces Tactical Gear cooldown by 20%.
■ Type I battlefield field supply device, pre-packaged with various common materials tailored to each Operator's Tactical Gear characteristics. Once opened, it accelerates Tactical Gear recharge.
○ Haavk Neurofluid - Ultra Form: For 180 seconds after use, when an enemy aims at you, the screen edge lights up in their direction; obtainable from Bosses or Special Classes, single-match use only.

A cutting-edge combat stimulant popular among elite Haavk soldiers. Significantly enhances crisis awareness during its active period, allowing instant identification of incoming enemy fire direction within a certain range.

○ Haavk Neuro-Analgesic: For 240 seconds after use, grants Pain Relief effect and suppresses the debuff that reduces maximum HP when injured; obtainable from Bosses or Special Classes, single-match use only.

A cutting-edge combat stimulant popular among elite Haavk soldiers. Allows soldiers to ignore severe combat efficiency losses from bodily injuries during its active period, maintaining full operational effectiveness.
● New Limited-Time Mode - Neo Investigation
○ Mystic Neural Devices have flooded the black market. Ahsarah is shrouded in mystery. Use neural devices to decode buried secrets.

○ Purchase neural devices through events or Supply Stations. Explore scannable containers in battle to obtain hidden items, with chances to discover mysterious character voice lines. Neural devices also have additional functions—explore to discover them.
●Season Mission Update

○ S6 Season Mission Reset: All progress on Season 6 missions will be reset and cleared. Any Ultimate Safe Box Season Access from previous seasons, along with any Safe Box Trial Cards (used or unused), will expire and become invalid.
○ Homepage display optimization: The season mission homepage panel will now more clearly display mission progress and Operation Directives.
○ Season mission list: Optimized the red dot display rules for side missions in the season mission list.

○ Fate Contracts and Collector progress indication optimization: The required quantities for Fate Contracts and Collector will now display progress requirements based on the current season mission stage (whether Ultimate Safe Box Season Access has been obtained).

○ S7 Season Mission Update: Season 7 kicks off with a brand-new mission line, bringing fresh Operation Directives and Fate Contracts challenges for operators to tackle, featuring the following experience improvements:
○ Difficulty optimization: Significantly reduced the number of missions with "extraction failure resets mission progress."
○ Mission path optimization: Increased the number of default open Operation Directive side paths, providing more route options from the season start.
○ Map selection optimization: Reduced the number of missions requiring visits to Tide Prison and any Hard maps. Main missions do not require these visits.

○ Neural device series story experience: Season missions now include neural device-related narrative content. Use the Mystic Neural Device Type I to become a psychic agent and explore the undercurrents surging across the Ahsarah continent and uncover the secrets of various factions.

○ Obtaining Mystic Neural Device Type I: Complete missions to acquire large quantities of neural devices. Supply Stations and corresponding event screens will continuously provide Mystic Neural Device Type I.

● Operator - Claire Ann Byers (Codename: Tempest)
Operator Role: Assault

Operator Trait - Auxiliary Surge Spine: Tempest’s auxiliary spine activates when bullets or explosions come too close, releasing electric currents that supercharge her core muscles. This temporarily boosts her sprinting speed. When not under pressure, it passively increases her swimming speed.

Tactical Gear - Drill Charge: Tempest tosses a drill forward that can bust through tough surfaces. It then spews conductive powder and electric currents that pierce through cover, disarming enemies and temporarily paralyzing them.

Gadget - Combat Roll: This activates her auxiliary spine to amp up her core strength, letting her quickly roll in multiple directions. Successfully knocking down enemies reduces the gadget’s cooldown.

Gadget - Emergency Evasion Device: After Tempest pops in a gas canister, this device fires a Safety Rope to secure an Anchor Point. If she reactivates the device or receives fatal damage, she'll be yanked back to that anchor spot.
Operations Mode: When downed, Tempest can activate her spine to discharge a defibrillation burst, reviving herself once.
Warfare Mode: During the rope pullback, Tempest briefly resists damage that would normally exceed her max HP.
The Safety Rope will go into a suspended state if Tempest falls a certain distance.
How to Unlock: Available in the free tier of the Season Pass.
"Raven was once the former Ahsarah king's most cherished and brilliant son, but he was later betrayed and ended up a prisoner..."
